source_row.stem: A nursing unit conducts brief daily safety huddles. The primary purpose is to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fully replacing the need for any other form of team communication for the remainder of the shift","B":"Focusing mainly on administrative scheduling matters rather than on client safety concerns for the day","C":"Serving mainly as a venue for assigning disciplinary action related to recent errors on the unit","D":"Proactively identify and discuss safety concerns or risks for the day, supporting a shared awareness among the team"}}
source_row.rationale: Daily safety huddles proactively identify and discuss safety concerns or risks for the day, supporting shared situational awareness among the team and enabling early identification of potential issues.
